Rate this Yelp review from 1–5. Return ONLY the digit.

This is the kind of place you can imagine the Sex Pistols hanging out at in the early 80s, it's a really unique spot (especially the second floor bar/lounge area). The first floor is a fairy typical bar and seating area, they've got a decent looking menu, some cheap beer specials, weekly specials and events, and baskets of carnival/dollar store type toys which is pretty funny and adds to the unique vibe to the place. The second floor is completely outrageous with it's graffiti and photo plastered walls, they've got a second bar upstairs, a pool table, and plenty of lounge type seating including a few bumper cars to sit around in. Tattooed Mom is a fun and unique spot and is worth checking out if only for a couple cheap beers and a game of pool.

Great food! I love the taste of their fresh bagels. And the owners and staff are so friendly! Great quick breakfast spot. Today I tried a bagel melt for the first time. Amazing!

We took our toddler to breakfast one morning and really wished we had skip this place.  We ve been before and it's an ok place.  People seem to love it but I think it's overrated.
Our server was down right rude to my daughter.  Apparently playing with the sugar packets was not acceptable.  She seemed annoyed that I sent back my lipstick coffee mug ( super gross).
The food was average.  I had a $10 bagel sandwich which was not even that good.  My husbands was expensive too and not that good. 
We will never be back!

This place has good food...loved the noodles. I ordered a take out and was ready on time.

I am a F.A.N. Bangkok Jazz has the best lunch buffet in downtown Indy but let's be honest, probably has some of the best Thai food in Indy. So much that it's my default "let's have lunch" spot or random, I don't know what to have for dinner.  I say this, because it never fails to be amazing and the portions are big enough for 2 meals!

Since it is right downtown, it can be hard to find parking during the lunch hours.  Dinner time is perfect.  The vibe inside the restaurant is chill and I always leave more relaxed and satisfied than when I entered!

Hermitage Hotel is the only 5 star hotel in Tennessee.

Our adventure began this past wknd while at the Yelp Spring Fling wknd festivities. I've lived in Nashville for over 10 yrs and never have i stopped by to tour the place.

As you walk in, you walk up these steps that lead you to the main foyer where you can check in and take in the view. To the right was a staircase leading down to the restaurant Capitol Grille and also the Secret Bathroom!

i didn't get to tour much of the hotel since that was the extent of my visit but i'm pretty sure the rest of the hotel is just as extravagent as what i saw.

Stroganoff burger and tots were really good.  It's messy, in case trying to impress anyone.  Plus, for those of us that don't drink, it actually has a non-alcoholic drink menu.  Pharmacy cream soda was delicious.

Besides taste, I went on a random Tuesday.  After I ordered, I tried to read and didn't finish a whole page before the food was ready.  Might have gotten a little distracted with smartphone, social-media surfing, but still unbelievably quick.

Rate this Yelp review from 1–5. Return ONLY the digit.

It was our second visit here. We were seated on the outside patio on this cold night. 

I ordered the Spicy Miso - which is not at all too spicy. Delicious & the right amount of heat. I tried some of the Tennessee Tonkotsu - just as equally tasty. Recommendation: always order extra noodles. One order is good for two people. 

The reason for the 4 stars was the service/seating. Nothing over the top, but always caught us when we had a full mouth of food. It was a cold day, but even with the indoor heating, it still had us in jackets. We saw other tables with jackets on, too!

I'm from the east coast, and until I went to Bagel Fair I didn't think good bagels existed in Indianapolis.

This place is a rowdy panic attack cluster f**k of nonsense. I was expecting a nice corporate little group outing, and what I got felt like I was in a busy White Castle in a really bad part of town. Even the parking lot was rowdy. Not just because of the brain dead valet crew, but there were just hooligans horsing around and playing around on the stairs and being obnoxious. Im still baffled by the aggressiveness of the security guard who stopped my as I was walking in to reprimand me for stopping, and when I said "well I was walking and then you stopped me," he snapped back angrily "MY JOB IS TO STOP PEOPLE". Was he on drugs?

We will never be back.
